style: An original female character named Luna, a young adult mission secretary. A clear, lightly bright, cute but dignified voice, warm and composed, with quiet courage and wonder. Natural English, medium-high pitch without squeaking, precise articulation, a gentle smile. Cinematic intimacy rather than advertising. No impersonation, no music, no background sound. Keep each line concise with natural short pauses.

clips.text: Every city begins with a dream. Together, we turn knowledge into tomorrow.
Beyond the sky, we carry the courage of everyone who came before us.
On the Moon, a small light becomes our next step into the unknown.
Across a silent red world, every discovery brings a distant home closer.
Someday, we will call this planet home. Commander, our future begins with you.
Let's begin with a residential district. Choose the building, pick an empty plot, then confirm construction.
I'll give our first construction a little help. Ask me to finish it, and we'll have it ready right away.
All done! Our homes now bring in tax revenue every minute. Look at the balance above to see what's left after upkeep.
Next, let's research life support. The income from our city will help us learn how to live among the stars.
Research is underway! Future buildings take time, but you can keep planning while they grow. I'll be here in the guide whenever you need me.
